sources.title: MOSS-Audio-Tokenizer - GitHub
sources.snippet: MOSS-Audio-Tokenizer is a unified discrete audio tokenizer based on the Cat (C ausal A udio T okenizer with T ransformer) architecture. Scaling to 1.6 billion parameters, it functions as a unified discrete interface, delivering both lossless-quality reconstruction and high-level semantic alignment.
